name: Shin Koihime † Musou -Kakumei- Son Go no Ketsumyaku
original_name: 真・恋姫†夢想-革命- 孫呉の血脈
source:
Go version of the Shin Koihime † Musou - Kakumei series. The Kakumei series aim to deepen the story of Gi, Go and Shoku in a restart from 0 with new scenes and stories for existing and new heroines routes. There are new characters that didn't appear in Souten no Haou.

The famous Sonken Bundai, who was mentioned so many times throughout the series finally makes it's appearance as a central character. The story was completely revised and new content was added for a total 4 times Shin Koihime † Musou's Go's route events. Even those who played Shin Koihime † Musou will enjoy new emotions this game will bring.

[Roughly translated from [url=http://baseson.nexton-net.jp/kakumei-go/about/]official website[/url].]
translation:
《真恋姬 † 无双 - 角明》系列的Go版本。《觉明》系列旨在从0重新开始，深化《道》、《围》和《食》的故事，为现有和新的女主角路线提供新的场景和故事。还有《苍天霸王》中没有出现的新角色。

在整个系列中多次被提及的著名的Sonken Bundai终于作为中心人物出现了。新恋姬†无双围棋路线事件共计4次，故事经过彻底修改，并添加了新内容。即使是那些玩过真恋姬†无双的人也会享受这款游戏带来的新情感。

[大致翻译自[url=http://baseson.nexton-net.jp/kakumei-go/about/]官方网站[/url]。]
